question: What is the meaning of product certification and labels in relation to health and safety aspects?
description: Product certification and labels provide a guideline about making selective choices based on health and safety aspects. They can be used to assess and label hazardous chemicals and materials, and to provide information on the health and safety aspects of a product. Examples include GHS, MSDS, and product assessments and certifications. These labels and certifications can be mandatory or voluntary, and they can be used to complement materials passports.
